routes.mount: Lazy PowerDashboards inside SafeRoute; route source found by scoped search, not navigated.

purpose: Manual Grafana-oriented dashboard JSON composer with an install-wide six-panel reference catalog and an optional, explicitly applied Helix draft.
primaryGoal: Create or edit a persistent user-owned JSON envelope, optionally review/apply an AI proposal, then copy the JSON for manual use in Grafana. This is not the home dashboard widget configuration screen.

dataSources.name: Manual editor draft
dataSources.behavior: Restore ai.dashboardComposer.draft verbatim; persist every nonempty edit, including whitespace; remove the key for an empty string; storage exceptions are swallowed. Copy trims the payload but does not rewrite the saved value.

dataSources.name: Curated catalog
dataSources.hook: Local constant plus memoized name sorting
dataSources.owner: Page constant; matching backend whitelist in internal\api\ainldash\handler.go
dataSources.behavior: Six static metadata entries, not six fetched fleet measurements. Descriptions mention distance_m, energy_used_wh and source tables; neither SQL execution nor actual panel-template availability was established.

dataSources.name: AI draft stream
dataSources.behavior: Bare URL receives the canonical /api/v1 prefix. POST body is {prompt: trimmedInput}; only successful draft_dashboard_layout tool_result events are parsed. Draft remains separate from editor until Apply. No Grafana push endpoint is called.
dataSources.knownShape: DashboardLayoutDraft {prompt, dashboard:{title, slots:[{panel_name, grid_pos:{x,y,w,h}}]}, rationale, referenced_panels}; finite numeric grid positions checked client-side.
dataSources.limits: Route binding verified in source only; authentication, provider, server layout validation, SSE availability and Grafana import compatibility were not exercised.

dataSources.name: AI configuration gate
dataSources.behavior: Existing settings query key ['settings'], five-minute stale time, refetchOnMount always, retry 1. Default ai_mode off and empty flags hide the AI section; non-off mode and exact true nl-dashboard-composer flag enable it. Missing settings use existing defaults; no page-owned preference writes.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer / Grid
components.contract: Page title/subtitle, inherited shell and full-width min-w-0 container; cols default 1/xl 3/3xl 4, gap 4. Do not add a competing page-width or workspace selector owner.

components.name: Button / CopyButton / Textarea / GlassPanel / Heading / Text / HelperText
components.contract: Keep category imports, native controlled textarea, accessible name, spellCheck false, monospaced JSON, trim-aware Copy, whitespace-aware Clear, copy callbacks and stable persistence key. CopyButton invalidates pending feedback after text changes/unmount.

components.name: InlineCallout
components.contract: success/warning with icon plus localized copy guidance; non-action callout renders role=status.

components.name: AINLDashboardComposer / AIFeatureCard / AiOutputPanel / withAiFeature
components.contract: Preserve nl-dashboard-composer gate, prompt, Ask Helix contextual accessible name, streaming/disabled state, output/activity/usage presentation and separate Apply callback. Internal shared concrete imports are intentional, not feature barrel violations.

components.name: FadeIn / usePageTitle
components.contract: Keep reduced-motion preference delegation and titleStore integration; no additional motion or document-title manager.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Six name/description pairs duplicate the backend curated whitelist exactly at the inspected snapshot. This is intentional static reference data, but two manually edited owners can drift.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the current six entries and stable identifiers. If catalog maintenance is centralized later, coordinate a generated/shared metadata contract with backend ownership; do not invent a catalog endpoint during visual modernization.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Workflow steps and catalog entries repeat low-chrome bordered list-item presentation, but have different semantics and only this page was audited.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing primitives; retain local list rendering unless independent-consumer evidence establishes a shared composite need.

sourceStrategy: Workflow stacks by default and uses three columns at sm: page 251.
Editor/catalog stack below xl; editor spans two of three xl columns; both span two of four 3xl columns: page 51, 282-283, 340.
Catalog changes 1 -> 2 at sm -> 1 at xl -> 2 at 3xl: page 351.
Wrapping action rows, wrapLabel, min-w-0, break-words headings and break-all panel identifiers resist overflow: page 284, 306-318, 341, 361.

issues.detail: Three workflow columns at sm and two catalog columns at sm are viewport-driven; narrow allocated shell/container widths and long localized descriptions may become cramped. This is a test risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Exercise the existing layout at all ten contract widths, reduced allocated width, RTL and 200% text before changing breakpoints; retain all steps/catalog entries on mobile.

responsive.runtimeStatus: Unverified; no viewport, screenshot, compiled breakpoint or overflow measurements.

sourceStrengths: Three section h2 headings, ordered workflow and unordered catalog lists: page 242, 251, 284, 341, 351.
JSON editor and AI prompt have localized aria-labels: page 302; AINLDashboardComposer 189.
Decorative page icons are aria-hidden; noncolor panel-kind glyphs retained: page 91-96, 257-258, 285, 342.
Shared Textarea supplies stable useId, descriptions and focus token classes; page currently supplies no visible primitive label or associated hint.
Clipboard feedback uses InlineCallout role=status and CopyButton aria-live; AI errors use role=alert.
FadeIn delegates reduced motion, rather than implementing a page-level animation policy.

issues.detail: Editor has an accessible name, but adjacent manual-copy/Grafana guidance is not associated via aria-describedby. AI prompt similarly relies on aria-label and an unassociated surrounding description.
issues.fix: Associate existing localized helper content through stable explicit IDs/aria-describedby or the existing Textarea hint API; preserve wording and controlled-field behavior.

issues.detail: Default md minimum height is 40px; sm AI actions use 36px. These are below the design-contract 44px mobile default, but actual composed targets and WCAG spacing exceptions were not measured.
issues.fix: Use existing lg/density options where suitable; shared owner should review opt-in mobile target sizing without altering every caller's saved density/default. Validate localized wrapped labels and reachability.

accessibility.runtimeStatus: Keyboard, actual focus order/restoration, screen-reader announcements, contrast, target dimensions, forced colors and OS reduced-motion behavior are unverified.

manual.initial: Immediate local draft or blank editor; no network loading gate appropriate for this source.
manual.empty: Editable textarea placeholder; Copy/Clear disabled for empty input. Whitespace disables only Copy.
manual.success: Localized copied-to-Grafana guidance; editor remains intact.
manual.error: Clipboard unavailable/rejected warnings retain editor and instruct manual selection/copy.
manual.persistenceFailure: Storage read/write errors silently degrade; no persistence-failure notice exists.
manual.offlineStale: No fleet query or freshness value in manual editor; do not label user text stale or replace it with a network error.

ai.offOrUnresolvedSettings: Only AI section omitted; manual/editor/catalog remain visible.
ai.idle: Empty prompt disables draft action; output omitted before a stream.
ai.loading: Streaming disables draft/apply and supplies thinking/output feedback through shared owner.
ai.empty: Done without text displays No output was generated; a typed draft can still independently exist.
ai.error: Shared alert displays stream error; manual source remains independent and re-draft is available when not streaming.
ai.partial: Invalid individual draft slots are silently removed by parser; omitted slots produce an empty array. No truncation summary is surfaced.
ai.offlineStale: No explicit offline versus HTTP/SSE error presentation in this composition; no source timestamp or synthetic freshness should be invented.

issues.detail: Raw hook errors such as stream_http_404 or stream_incomplete can be shown directly. They do not explain recovery or distinguish unavailable/offline states in user language.
issues.fix: Shared AI owner should map known transport codes to localized, actionable messages while retaining source diagnostics, existing output/activity, manual baseline and re-draft behavior. Do not infer offline from every failure.

issues.detail: Client parser drops invalid slots and defaults absent slots to []; a parseable partial proposal may be applied without a notice. This is a source behavior, not evidence that the server actually emits malformed drafts.
issues.fix: Integration owner should review exposing partial/malformed-proposal feedback, retaining the current editor until explicit Apply and preserving existing valid slot handling; do not silently change the tool/wire contract during presentation work.

states.runtimeStatus: All state descriptions are source inspection, not executed interactions.

visualIssues.detail: Repeated fixed cyan rings/icons plus all six cyan identifiers and heading icons spend accent emphasis on reference decoration. Fixed text-cyan-300 also bypasses theme-aware text contrast.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border/primary-secondary text tokens for workflow and catalog chrome; reserve accent for the primary copy action or meaningful state, retaining icons and identifiers.

visualIssues.detail: Catalog icon tiles use fixed white-alpha background and ring rather than shared theme surfaces. These are low-alpha whites, not pure-white body text; actual visual noise/contrast was not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Replace decorative white-alpha chrome with existing neutral surface/control border tokens; do not create another card wrapper.

visualIssues.detail: Shared AI CTA overrides outline chrome with fixed cyan border/background/text/hover/focus intensities, including border-cyan-400/70 and dark:text-cyan-100. Badge also repeats cyan styling. It competes visually with the editor primary action.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should restrain existing AI card/button/badge using canonical tokens and semantic Button variants, preserving Helix identity, labels, disabled/busy behavior and all children/output slots.

visualIssues.detail: Shared output surface uses bg-white/[0.02]; fixed red-300 error text is not theme-aware. No measured contrast failure is claimed.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt existing surface and semantic error/text tokens in the shared renderer while keeping alert semantics and streamed/evidence content.

architectureIssues.detail: Catalog descriptions are rendered directly from English literals, unlike surrounding localized labels. Identifiers are protocol data and should remain untranslated.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize description presentation through the existing canonical catalog process while preserving all six original meanings, SI SQL identifiers and stable panel names. Catalog edits need their designated shared owner.

architectureIssues.detail: Comments and instructions call the typed title/slots envelope Grafana-ready, but no conversion into Grafana native panel JSON or actual import acceptance was inspected. Manual input also has no JSON parse/validation barrier by design.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve freeform manual editing/copy and no-push behavior. Record Grafana compatibility as integration QA unknown; do not promise verified import, add a push action, or impose validation that removes current manual capability.

priority.rationale: Manual workflow already uses shared layout/primitives, source-independent states and explicit AI consent. Prioritize theme-neutral reference chrome, localized catalog descriptions, helper association and shared AI error/target review; do not turn this into a fleet-metric dashboard.
priority.acceptanceDependency: Shared AI presentation review and focused integration/browser QA, not a speculative backend rewrite.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained AIFeatureCard presentation and mobile action sizing
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Retain title, description, buttonLabel, badgeLabel, canStart, stream, inputSlot, children, buttonPlacement, onAction and contextual accessible action name; neutral outline chrome; idle/streaming/disabled/busy and wrapped mobile action reachability.
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Other AI consumers were not audited; coordinate existing shared owner, not a replacement AI card.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Theme-aware, actionable AI output/error presentation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Retain text/state/error/activity/usage/pendingChild, null idle output, initial thinking placeholder, streamed partial text, done-empty, alert error and evidence trail. Present known error codes with localized recovery and neutral surfaces; do not discard retained content or infer offline.
dependsOn: Existing canonical i18n catalogs and semantic tokens
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: No additional shared component or backend endpoint is required by this report.

competingImplementations.limits: No app-wide search/inventory or claim that all competing implementations are absent. Existing static catalog duplication is documented separately.

sections.name: How it works
sections.preserve: Intro and all three numbered pick/compose/copy instructions.

sections.name: Helix natural-language dashboard composer
sections.preserve: Optional feature-gated prompt, draft/output/evidence and explicit Apply; intentionally absent in AI-off mode.

sections.name: Manual dashboard JSON editor
sections.preserve: 18-row monospaced freeform editor, hint/placeholder/accessibility, Copy/Clear and status.

sections.name: Curated panel catalog
sections.preserve: All six names, descriptions, alphabetical ordering and type glyphs.

actions.name: Edit JSON
actions.behavior: Accept arbitrary text; clear prior status; persist raw editor value without silently parsing/reformatting.

actions.name: Copy to clipboard
actions.behavior: Enabled only for non-whitespace; copy trimmed text; success and manual-copy fallback warnings leave editor intact.

actions.name: Clear
actions.behavior: Enabled even for whitespace-only content; empty editor, clear status and remove persisted key.

actions.name: Ask Helix / Draft dashboard
actions.behavior: Requires trimmed prompt and enabled AI setting; reset candidate at new draft start; guard duplicate streaming submission.

actions.name: Apply to editor
actions.behavior: Explicit action replaces only editor JSON with pretty-printed draft.dashboard and clears status; output is not auto-applied or pushed.

actions.name: Manual selection/copy and retry after clipboard failure
actions.behavior: Retain full text for native keyboard selection/copy; do not navigate away or discard user input.

configuration: Preserve localStorage key ai.dashboardComposer.draft and raw value semantics across navigation/reload.
Preserve ai_mode and ai_features['nl-dashboard-composer'] opt-in and no automatic configuration mutations.
Preserve theme/density/font/locale preferences through existing primitives; do not reset persisted neon-cyan theme ID.
Do not add vehicle/date selectors or wire header scope into this static install-wide catalog without an actual backend contract.
No fleet statistics, chart series, saved-dashboard CRUD, direct Grafana push, authentication tokens or invented measurements are present in the page.
